xyz.refinedev.practice.api.leaderboard

Interface LeaderboardAPI


  • public interface LeaderboardAPI

    This code is the property of Refine Development.
    Copyright © 2025, All Rights Reserved.

    The LeaderboardAPI interface provides methods to interact with player leaderboards. It allows fetching leaderboards for specific kits or globally, updating the leaderboard data, and clearing cached data. This service access the 'bolt-statistics' collection in the database.
    Since:
    9/18/2025

    • Method Detail

      • update

        void update()
        Updates the leaderboards by fetching the latest data from the database. This method should be called asynchronously to avoid blocking the main thread. It refreshes the cached leaderboard data to ensure it is up-to-date.

      • clearCache

        void clearCache()
        Clears the cached leaderboard data.

      • fetchKitLeaderboard

        java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<IKitLeaderboard> fetchKitLeaderboard(IKit kit,
                                                                            int amount,
                                                                            LeaderboardType type)
        Fetches the leaderboard for a specific IKit and type.
        Parameters:
        kit - The IKit to fetch the leaderboard for.
        amount - The number of top entries to retrieve.
        type - The type of leaderboard to fetch (e.g., ELO, WINS, KILLS).
        Returns:
        A CompletableFuture that will complete with an IKitLeaderboard object representing the leaderboard for the specified kit and type.

      • fetchGlobalLeaderboard

        java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<ILeaderboardEntry[]> fetchGlobalLeaderboard(int amount,
                                                                                   LeaderboardType type)
        Fetches the global leaderboard for the specified type.
        Parameters:
        type - The type of leaderboard to fetch (e.g., ELO, WINS, KILLS).
        amount - The number of top entries to retrieve.
        Returns:
        A CompletableFuture that will complete with an array of ILeaderboardEntry objects representing the top players.
